verification.detail: Kernel executed on Model/Ascend950PR_9599, verification passed

notes: Golden kernel verified on the CANN 9.0.0 simulator (Ascend950PR_9599 / C310 / arch35) in Docker via tests/tools/run_and_verify.py --mode simulator. High-level LayerNorm (mean subtraction + beta) with full_row and split_d kernels plus a host-side N-D flatten dispatcher: any N-D input flattens on the host to [rows, last_dim] and normalizes over the last axis. Variance computed as E[x^2] - mean^2 (merged sum_x + sum_x2 pass) so host zero padding does not bias the statistics. full_row when num_cols % 8 == 0 and num_cols*4*6 <= 64 KiB UB budget; otherwise split_d (tile_cols=64). Inputs are torch.Tensor (numpy is silently zeroed on the C310 path). Verified shapes cover both 2-D and 3-D inputs and both dispatcher paths: [8,768], [8,152], [8,256], [8,4096], [8,384], [4,52,10], [2,3,250], [2,3,512], [4,5,32], [4,5,16], [2,4,16], [4,3,64], [4,4,128], [2,3,384], [2,4,512], [2,3,160], [2,3,64] against torch.nn.functional.layer_norm (atol=rtol=2e-2 full_row, 5e-2 split_d).
